## Change and purpose

Describe the problem and how this change addresses it. Link a relevant issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks you ran and their results. State what you could not verify.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has one clear purpose.
- [ ] Instructions and relative links work, if documentation changed.
- [ ] Runnable examples include setup and validation instructions, if applicable.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, private data, or unrelated generated files.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passed before committing.
